composition: Symmetrical, centered framing with the subject occupying exactly 55% to 65% of the canvas area.
Maintain a 1:1 square aspect ratio with balanced negative space surrounding the central icon.
Incorporate dynamic diagonal elements or silhouettes angled upward-right at approximately 45 degrees to create movement.
Ensure consistent stroke weights and precise geometric curves to anchor the central shape.
typographie: No text should be embedded within the generated icon graphic itself.
External text layers must be placed below the icon, scaled to a maximum of 15% of the canvas height.
Use high-contrast, clean sans-serif typefaces in pure white (#FFFFFF) to match the icon's visual weight.
lumiere: Zero gradients, zero drop shadows, and zero directional light sources.
Absolute flat fill across the entire subject shape.
effets: Sharp, clean vector-like edge rendering with zero anti-aliasing artifacts.
High-contrast negative space cutouts within solid shapes to define internal details.
logo: Single, recognizable brand silhouette or simplified vector icon centered perfectly on the canvas.
interdits: Do not use color gradients, gray tones, or midtones.
Avoid fuzzy, soft, or pixelated edges on the vector paths.
Do not include off-center compositions unless balanced by a strong diagonal element.
Avoid complex, multi-layered shapes that reduce legibility at small sizes.
